description: This script interacts with MISP to create and upload security threat intelligence events based on IOC files, including parsing IOC XML content, creating attributes, and tagging events.

methods.name: misp_init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a PyMISP instance with provided URL and key.

methods.name: check_valid_ioc
methods.description: Checks if the IOC file has a valid extension and is not empty.

methods.name: get_parse_ioc_file
methods.description: Parses the IOC file with BeautifulSoup using lxml parser.

methods.name: parse_ioc_search_content
methods.description: Maps IOC context search terms to MISP mapping values.

methods.name: create_attribute_json
methods.description: Creates a JSON attribute for MISP based on IOC context, value, comment, and force flag.

methods.name: create_attributes_from_ioc_json
methods.description: Extracts attributes from IOC XML content and returns a list of attribute JSON objects.

methods.name: create_misp_event_json
methods.description: Builds a MISP event JSON object from attributes and IOC descriptions.

methods.name: get_descriptions
methods.description: Extracts specific description text from the XML soup.

methods.name: save_ioc_description
methods.description: Saves IOC descriptions into a global dictionary.

methods.name: get_taxonomy
methods.description: Generates taxonomy tags from IOC XML content and CSV mapping.

methods.name: custum_color_tag
methods.description: Returns color code based on tag content.

methods.name: push_event_to_misp
methods.description: Uploads a JSON event to MISP and stores the event ID.

methods.name: upload_file
methods.description: Uploads IOC sample file to MISP.

methods.name: update_tag
methods.description: Creates and associates tags with the MISP event.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution flow: parses arguments, validates IOC file, creates event, uploads data, and tags.
